WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    -- Base: direct components of the model
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND uc.parent_code = 'ER6-120GRY30-0515'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: components of assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        bom.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = (SELECT component_code FROM component WHERE component_id = bom.component_id)
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE bom.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND uc.parent_kind = 'component'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_assembly = FALSE THEN total_qty * unit_cost ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_parts_cost
FROM bom;
```

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Build the full composition tree from SKUs down to components
-- Start with SKU -> model edges and SKU -> SKU (bundle) edges
sku_tree AS (
    -- Base: direct SKU to model mappings
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS sku_code,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS model_qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
    SELECT 
        c1.parent_code AS sku_code,
        c2.child_code AS model_code,
        c1.qty * c2.qty AS model_qty,
        c1.valid_from,
        c1.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c1
    JOIN u_composition c2 ON c1.child_code = c2.parent_code
    WHERE c1.parent_kind = 'sku'

    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND s.is_bundle = TRUE
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),

-- Now we need to trace from each SKU (root) down to the specific model VI1-160BLK76-0270
-- For non-bundle SKUs: direct edge to model
-- For bundle SKUs: edge to item SKU, then item SKU to model

-- Let's use u_explosion which is already materialized
-- u_explosion has root_kind, root_code, item_kind, item_code, qty
-- We want rows where item_kind = 'model' and item_code = 'VI1-160BLK76-0270'
-- and root_kind = 'sku'

model_qty_per_sku AS (
    SELECT 
        root_code AS sku_code,
        SUM(qty) AS total_model_qty
    FROM u_explosion
    WHERE root_kind = 'sku'
      AND item_kind = 'model'
      AND item_code = 'VI1-160BLK76-0270'
      AND valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    GROUP BY root_code
),

-- Get all completed orders in 2024
completed_orders_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
),

-- Join with listing to get SKU
order_sku_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        col.order_id,
        col.line_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        s.sku_code
    FROM completed_orders_2024 col
    JOIN listing l ON col.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
),

-- Join with model quantity per SKU
order_model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        osl.order_id,
        osl.line_qty * mq.total_model_qty AS model_units
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    JOIN model_qty_per_sku mq ON osl.sku_code = mq.sku_code
)

SELECT 
    SUM(model_units) AS total_model_units_sold
FROM order_model_units;
```

),
valid_edges AS (
    SELECT c.parent_kind, c.parent_code, c.child_kind, c.child_code, c.qty
    FROM u_composition c, params p
    WHERE c.valid_from <= p.d
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR p.d <= c.valid_to)
),
walk AS (
    SELECT e.child_kind AS kind, e.child_code AS code, CAST(e.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty
    FROM valid_edges e
    WHERE e.parent_kind = 'sku' AND e.parent_code = 'BDL-CA-0316'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.child_kind, e.child_code, w.qty * e.qty
    FROM walk w
    JOIN valid_edges e
      ON e.parent_kind = w.kind AND e.parent_code = w.code
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS units
FROM walk
WHERE kind = 'component' AND code = 'FOO-680-BLK-01235';

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the order lines for completed orders from Amazon-US-00 in 2024
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        o.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        ss.sku_code,
        ss.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON l.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.store_name = 'Amazon-US-00'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode the BOM
-- Start from the SKU level
bom_exploded AS (
    -- Base case: SKU -> Model or SKU -> SKU (for bundles)
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_qty,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_code,
        ol.line_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = ol.sku_code
        AND uc.valid_from <= ol.order_date
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= ol.order_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: Model -> Component or Component -> Component
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.line_qty,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_code,

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Build the full explosion from u_composition for all roots (SKUs)
-- We need to trace from SKU -> model -> components, but we only care about model-level quantities
-- Actually, we need: for each SKU, how many units of each model are contained (counting bundles)

-- Step 1: Get direct SKU -> model edges (non-bundle SKUs)
-- Step 2: Get bundle SKU -> item SKU edges, then item SKU -> model edges
-- We can use u_explosion which already has the materialized quantities

-- u_explosion has root_kind, root_code, item_kind, item_code, qty
-- For a SKU root, item_kind='model' gives us the model quantity per unit of that SKU

-- Get all completed orders in US in 2025
completed_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        s.sku_code
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store st ON l.store_id = st.store_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'US'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
),

-- For each order line, get the SKU and its model explosion
-- u_explosion: root_kind='sku', root_code=sku_code, item_kind='model', item_code=model_code, qty
-- qty is the number of that model per unit of the root SKU
sku_model_explosion AS (
    SELECT 
        root_code AS sku_code,
        item_code AS model_code,
        qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM u_explosion
    WHERE root_kind = 'sku'
      AND item_kind = 'model'
      AND valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),

-- Join orders with model explosion
order_model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        sme.model_code,
        SUM(co.line_qty * sme.model_qty_per_sku) AS total_units
    FROM completed_orders co
    JOIN sku_model_explosion sme ON co.sku_code = sme.sku_code
    GROUP BY sme.model_code
)

SELECT model_code
FROM order_model_units
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the store ID for Amazon-DE-01
store_info AS (
    SELECT store_id
    FROM store
    WHERE store_name = 'Amazon-DE-01'
),
-- Get completed orders for that store in 2024
completed_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store_info s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
),
-- Get order lines with their SKUs and quantities
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        sk.sku_code
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN completed_orders co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode the BOM
-- Start from each SKU in the order lines
bom_exploded AS (
    -- Base case: SKU -> child items (models or item SKUs for bundles)
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_code,
        co.order_date
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN completed_orders co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = ol.sku_code
        AND uc.valid_from <= co.order_date
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR co.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: if child is a model, go to components
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.total_qty * uc.qty,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_code,
        be.order_date
    FROM bom_exploded be
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = be.child_kind 
        AND uc.parent_code = be.child_code
        AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: if child is a component (assembly), go to sub-components
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.total_qty * uc.qty,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_code,
        be.order_date
    FROM bom_exploded be
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'component' 
        AND uc.parent_code = be.child_code
        AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
)
-- Sum up the quantity of the specific part
SELECT 
    SUM(be.total_qty) AS total_units
FROM bom_exploded be
WHERE be.child_kind = 'component'
  AND be.child_code = 'CAB-856-BLK-00745';

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Build the full explosion from u_composition for all roots (SKUs)
-- We need to find all components (models) under each SKU, with total qty
-- Start: SKU -> child (model or SKU)
explosion AS (
    -- Base: direct children of SKUs
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS sku_code,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand child SKUs (bundles containing SKUs)
    SELECT 
        e.sku_code,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        e.total_qty * c.qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' 
                         AND c.parent_code = e.child_code
    WHERE e.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
)
-- Now we have all items under each SKU. We want only company models.

WITH RECURSIVE lines AS (
    SELECT o.order_date, s.sku_code, ol.qty
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
    WHERE st.store_name = 'Wayfair-JP-23'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <  DATE '2024-01-01'
),
roots AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sku_code, order_date FROM lines
),
expl AS (
    SELECT r.sku_code AS root_code, r.order_date,
           'sku'::VARCHAR AS kind, r.sku_code AS code, 1.0::DOUBLE AS mult
    FROM roots r
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.root_code, e.order_date, c.child_kind, c.child_code,
           e.mult * c.qty
    FROM expl e
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = e.kind
     AND c.parent_code = e.code
     AND c.valid_from <= e.order_date
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= c.valid_to)
),
per_root AS (
    SELECT root_code, order_date, SUM(mult) AS part_qty
    FROM expl
    WHERE kind = 'component' AND code = 'LEG-148-WAL-02453'
    GROUP BY root_code, order_date
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.qty * p.part_qty), 0) AS units_consumed
FROM lines l
JOIN per_root p
  ON p.root_code = l.sku_code
 AND p.order_date = l.order_date;
```

SELECT e.item_code AS model_code
FROM orders o
JOIN store s       ON s.store_id = o.store_id
JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN listing l     ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
JOIN sales_sku k   ON k.sku_id = l.sku_id
JOIN u_explosion e ON e.root_kind = 'sku'
                  AND e.root_code = k.sku_code
                  AND e.item_kind = 'model'
                  AND e.valid_from <= o.order_date
                  AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= e.valid_to)
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND s.country = 'UK'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
  AND o.order_date <  DATE '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY e.item_code
ORDER BY SUM(ol.qty * e.qty) DESC, e.item_code
LIMIT 3;
